item.text:
Below is a compact research note based on 2024 web evidence only, with favorable and critical material mixed in. I kept the selection to strong, recoverable pages and separated 2024 events from background comparisons inside each claim.

## Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Brazil, 2024: initial evidence

- **Claim:** Lula entered 2024 with weak and statistically even approval, but not collapse-level support.
  - **Title:** [Brazil Lula's approval, disapproval statistically even, poll shows](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/approval-of-brazils-lulas-government-slightly-falls-ties-with-disapproval--poll-3348780)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via Investing.com
  - **Date:** March 21, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/approval-of-brazils-lulas-government-slightly-falls-ties-with-disapproval--poll-3348780
  - **Claim-level summary:** Datafolha put Lula’s approval at 35% and disapproval at 33%, within the margin of error. This is a 2024 domestic-support snapshot, with the comparison to December 2023 serving as background.
  - **Question IDs informed:** `7A/7B` broad support-legitimacy family; `8B` broad governance-effectiveness family

- **Claim:** By July 2024, Lula’s approval had rebounded to its highest level of the year, helped by public backing for his criticism of Brazil’s central bank.
  - **Title:** [Approval of Brazil's Lula goes up in July with support on cenbank view, poll shows](https://www.yahoo.com/news/approval-brazils-lula-goes-july-115612793.html)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via Yahoo News
  - **Date:** July 10, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.yahoo.com/news/approval-brazils-lula-goes-july-115612793.html
  - **Claim-level summary:** Genial/Quaest found Lula’s approval at 54% and disapproval at 43%, with 66% supporting his criticism of the central bank. The article also notes that market worries about fiscal targets and the real were already part of the 2024 context.
  - **Question IDs informed:** `7A/7B` support-legitimacy family; `8B` governance/economic-management family

- **Claim:** Lula’s 2024 economic management was under real fiscal pressure, even after a small improvement in the year’s deficit outlook.
  - **Title:** [Brazil's government improves fiscal outlook for the year](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-government-improves-fiscal-outlook-for-the-year-3626553)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via Investing.com
  - **Date:** September 20, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/brazils-government-improves-fiscal-outlook-for-the-year-3626553
  - **Claim-level summary:** The government cut its 2024 primary-deficit forecast to BRL 28.3 billion, but still needed a new spending freeze to stay within the fiscal rule. This is a useful critical indicator for economic stewardship in office.
  - **Question IDs informed:** `8B` governance/economic-effectiveness family

- **Claim:** Severe Amazon fires were a major 2024 stress test for Lula’s environmental record.
  - **Title:** [Brazil fire brigades fight Amazon blazes off to torrid start in 2024](https://theprint.in/world/brazil-fire-brigades-fight-amazon-blazes-off-to-torrid-start-in-2024/2216644/)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via ThePrint
  - **Date:** August 9, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://theprint.in/world/brazil-fire-brigades-fight-amazon-blazes-off-to-torrid-start-in-2024/2216644/
  - **Claim-level summary:** Reuters reported the Amazon’s worst fire season start in 20 years, driven by drought and climate conditions, and said this would be a tough test for Lula’s environmental stewardship.
  - **Question IDs informed:** `8B` policy-delivery/effectiveness family; possibly `4A` environmental governance family

- **Claim:** The Lula government publicly responded to climate risk in 2024 by creating new climate governance machinery.
  - **Title:** [Lula announces creation of climate authority](https://www.gov.br/mma/pt-br/lula-anuncia-criacao-de-autoridade-climatica)
  - **Publisher:** Brazil Ministry of Environment and Climate Change
  - **Date:** September 10, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/mma/pt-br/lula-anuncia-criacao-de-autoridade-climatica
  - **Claim-level summary:** The ministry said Lula announced a Climate Authority and a technical-scientific committee to coordinate extreme-climate response. This is a favorable policy-action claim, but it is an official government announcement rather than independent evaluation.
  - **Question IDs informed:** `8B` governance capacity/effectiveness family; `4A` environmental governance family

- **Claim:** By late 2024, official data showed substantial reductions in deforestation in Brazil’s major biomes.
  - **Title:** [Deforestation drops 30.6% in the Amazon and 25.7% in the Cerrado in 2024](https://www.gov.br/mma/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/taxa-de-desmatamento-na-amazonia-cai-30-6-e-25-7-no-cerrado)
  - **Publisher:** Brazil Ministry of Environment and Climate Change / INPE
  - **Date:** November 6, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/mma/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/taxa-de-desmatamento-na-amazonia-cai-30-6-e-25-7-no-cerrado
  - **Claim-level summary:** The official 2024 deforestation estimate for the Amazon fell 30.6% versus 2023, the lowest in nine years, and the Cerrado also fell 25.7%. This is one of the strongest favorable 2024 performance signals for Lula.
  - **Question IDs informed:** `8B` policy effectiveness family; `4A` environmental stewardship family

- **Claim:** Lula used the 2024 G20 and Amazon agenda to frame himself as a global climate leader.
  - **Title:** ["By 2030, we will announce to the world: zero deforestation in Brasil," states President Lula](https://www.gov.br/g20/en/news/by-2030-we-will-announce-to-the-world-zero-deforestation-in-brasil-states-president-lula)
  - **Publisher:** Brazil G20 official site
  - **Date:** December 4, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/g20/en/news/by-2030-we-will-announce-to-the-world-zero-deforestation-in-brasil-states-president-lula
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula launched a program targeting 70 municipalities responsible for most Amazon deforestation and pledged zero deforestation by 2030. This shows clear external-facing climate ambition, though it is also a self-stated objective.
  - **Question IDs informed:** `4A` foreign/environmental leadership family; `8B` effectiveness family

- **Claim:** Social-policy results by the end of 2024 were materially positive on hunger and poverty, at least in official government reporting tied to survey data.
  - **Title:** [2024: o ano do combate à fome e redução da pobreza](https://www.gov.br/mds/pt-br/noticias-e-conteudos/desenvolvimento-social/noticias-desenvolvimento-social/2024-o-ano-do-combate-a-fome-e-reducao-da-pobreza)
  - **Publisher:** Brazil Ministry of Social Development
  - **Date:** December 23, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/mds/pt-br/noticias-e-conteudos/desenvolvimento-social/noticias-desenvolvimento-social/2024-o-ano-do-combate-a-fome-e-reducao-da-pobreza
  - **Claim-level summary:** The ministry said 24.4 million people left severe food insecurity and poverty fell to its lowest level since 2012. This is favorable, but it is also a government summary of broader survey results, so it should be treated as supportive evidence rather than neutral adjudication.
  - **Question IDs informed:** `8B` social-policy effectiveness family; possibly `2A` welfare/redistribution family

- **Claim:** 2024 ended with record international tourism, which supports a more positive view of the administration’s macro backdrop and Brazil’s external image.
  - **Title:** [Brasil alcança marca de 6,6 milhões de turistas internacionais, a melhor da história](https://www.gov.br/secom/pt-br/acompanhe-a-secom/noticias/2024/12/brasil-alcanca-marca-de-6-6-milhoes-de-turistas-internacionais-a-melhor-da-historia)
  - **Publisher:** Secretaria de Comunicação Social, Brazil
  - **Date:** December 31, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/secom/pt-br/acompanhe-a-secom/noticias/2024/12/brasil-alcanca-marca-de-6-6-milhoes-de-turistas-internacionais-a-melhor-da-historia
  - **Claim-level summary:** Brazil said it received 6.621 million foreign tourists in 2024, a historical high. This is favorable context for the year, though not uniquely attributable to Lula.
  - **Question IDs informed:** `8B` economic-management / country-performance family

## Bottom line

2024 looked mixed for Lula: weak early-year approval and fiscal pressure were real negatives, while the second half of the year brought better polling, record tourism, and strong official climate and social-policy signals. The clearest favorable evidence is in environment and social protection; the clearest critical evidence is in approval volatility, fiscal strain, and the Amazon fire season.

If you want, I can turn this into a tighter evidence grid next.
